answer: Sybil resistance links equivocation evidence across bonded escrows: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting messages, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), rather than merely k. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases the swarm’s capital loss, so splitting stake among aliases cannot dilute accountability. A trellis of evidence can expose the timber of a coordinated gale, while asymmetric depreciation makes recovery slower than loss.
